title: Instrument prefill/decode kernel telemetry and enrich NVTX/trace spans
creator: Ayesha Kapoor
description:
Goal: improve fidelity of runtime profiling by adding structured per-kernel telemetry and richer NVTX/trace span tagging around prefill and decode phases. We are seeing opaque latency spikes that current traces collapse into large 'kernel' blocks. This work will: (1) emit per-kernel histograms and counts (op_type, kernel_impl, dtype, sequence_length_bucket, quantized_flag), (2) push NVTX ranges at the dispatch and per-invocation sub-loop level to preserve ordering of prefill vs decode work, and (3) augment trace spans with attributes used by Console to group regressions (model, model_variant, batch_size, request_origin, routing_policy). The higher-fidelity telemetry will help debug scheduling anomalies (kernel selection regressions, attention fast-path fallbacks) and validate batching/caching changes without heavy sampling.

Scope: runtime changes to the serving engine only (no API surface changes). Instrumentation should be lightweight and toggleable via config flags. Telemetry backend uses existing metrics ingestion (Prometheus/OTel bridge) and tracing (OTel -> Console).
tasks: Design telemetry schema for per-kernel metrics and NVTX range conventions
Add NVTX push/pop around kernel dispatch, kernel_init, attention_fastpath and attention_slowpath code paths
Emit kernel attributes as trace/span tags (op_type, impl, dtype, quantized, seq_len_bucket)
Add Prometheus histograms and counters for per-kernel duration and invocation counts
Integrate with existing OTel exporter and verify no high-cardinality tags are introduced
Create Console dashboards + alert rules for new metrics and traces
Rollout behind runtime flag and perform canary on internal Dedicated cluster
Document schema and migration notes for observability team
acceptance_criteria: New per-kernel histograms show up in metrics backend for all major operators within 1 week of canary
Trace spans include kernel_impl and seq_len_bucket tags without causing >5% increase in tracing traffic
Console dashboard can break down latency by op_type and kernel_impl and correlate with prefill/decode NVTX ranges
No measurable (>2%) P99 latency regression in workload perf tests when telemetry flag enabled
Runbook updated with examples to use new telemetry to triage kernel-selection regressions
comments: 2026-02-20 Ayesha Kapoor: Created ticket. Initial spike validated that prefill loops aggregate many small kernel calls; this hides per-op variance. Proposed solution: stamp NVTX and emit per-kernel histograms keyed by op signature.

2026-02-27 Miguel Santos: PoC added NVTX push/pop around attention kernels. Observed improved trace granularity but increased exported span count by ~18% in sample workload. Need to ensure OTel exporter sampling config to avoid backend overrun.
2026-03-03 Observability (Leah Park): Reviewed schema. Requested removing actual tensor shapes from tags to avoid cardinality explosion and suggested seq_len_bucket (<=32, 33-128, 129-512, >512).
2026-03-06 Miguel Santos: Implemented seq_len_bucket and op_impl tag. Added histograms with exponential buckets. Perf test shows 1.4% median latency delta with telemetry enabled (within target).

2026-03-10 SRE (Diego Ruiz): Canary started on internal-dedicated-1. Saw two regressions correlated to attention slowpath kernel; dashboards added to monitor. Preparing rollback plan if P99 breaches SLA.
2026-03-12 Ayesha Kapoor: Updated acceptance criteria and documented runbook steps. Next: finalize PR and schedule extension of traces to include routing_policy and model_variant.
